name: geqo_selection_bias
description: Controls selective pressure in the Genetic Query Optimizer (GEQO) population during query plan search.
symptoms: Suboptimal query plans for complex joins
Excessive planning time for large join queries
Inconsistent plan selection across similar queries
tuning_tips: Increase slightly (e.g., 1.7–2.0) to favor fitter individuals and converge faster; decrease toward 1.5 only if GEQO produces overly conservative or repetitive plans. Avoid values outside [1.5, 2.0] as they are unsupported.
